label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verse: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
note: The whole book of Obadiah is one chapter — and it starts with Edom's pride in its cliffside cities.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found _____ with God.
verse: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
note: Gabriel greets a startled young woman in Nazareth: fear not, Mary — you've found favour with God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And thou shalt write them upon the _____ of thy house, and on thy gates.
verse: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
note: Write God's words on the posts of your house and your gates — faith meant to be seen coming and going.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye are bought with a _____: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
verse: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
note: Paul's closing argument in a chapter on purity: your body has been purchased — treat it as the temple it is.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not _____ thy son, thine only son from me.
verse: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
note: At Moriah the knife was stopped: Abraham had not 'withheld' his only son — echoed in Romans 8:32's 'spared not his own Son.'
